images.caption: Figure 1:Left:GRPO and teacher guidance align early but later diverge, making teacher matching restrictive.Middle:GRPO’s supervision is sparse and task-level, while OPD is dense but teacher-bound.Right:RetireOPD uses both early and retires the teacher at the conflict point, surpassing it.

Figure 2:Training dynamics of the 3B student on ALFWorld.Left: success rate of the teacher branch and the student branch under GRPO+OPSD.Middle: success rate under GRPO, OPD, and GRPO+OPD.Right: teacher-student discrepancy under OPD and GRPO+OPD.

Figure 3:Overview of RetireOPD.(1) Teacher Construction: We optimize a skill-conditioned teacher with environmental rewards.(2) Joint Skill Internalization: the student learns from both GRPO and OPD training.(3) Adaptive Retirement: OPD supervision is removed by current policy.
